notes: Original official Global Android prefabs are verified against hotlist MD5 and byte count, with SHA256 retained. Full exact child-component path IDs and validator fields are preserved, including native flags rather than only descriptions. All selected skill ranks and promotion/potential talents come from the pinned Global tables. No module effects are selected implicitly.

Normal heals use original Front/Back OnAttack and source maxAnimScale1 (caps acceleration at 100ASPD). Tracked engine markers preserve source projectile speeds but do not claim original Unity particles, parabolic meshes, sounds, or native frame parity.

Tuye source normal S2 threshold 0.5 and emergency selected max_hp_ratio both have maxHpExcludeEqual0. Inclusive boundaries deliberately follow prefabs despite the skill description saying below. Native four-second output-heal checker and cached-ATK-only projectiles are interpreted at actual source healing output; barrier amount remains current ATK times selected shield coefficient, not talent-amplified healing.

Tuye S1 manual cast is interruptible before original Skill_1 OnAttack; fired heal/barrier survives withdrawal. S2 Bullet has explicit preDelay0.5, cooldown selected skill_interval and source polling0.1. Native progress countEvent4 and FSM dispatcher are not executable-recovered: runtime decrements the three emergency casts at successful projectile launch, cancels unfired controlled casts, and ends after the third launch without canceling fired flight.

Ceylon trait uses exact inner2-3 range and S1 disables the far-heal penalty. Water talent uses original stage-tag checker water; no terrain inference. S2 continuous Resist aura follows eligible current range recipients and removes only its own effect on skill end, departure or withdrawal.

Paprika primary source trigger is WALK, while chain selector accepts ALL motion within original x-4 (adjacent eight tiles plus center). Speed10 flight occurs for every successive link, no revisits, selected max_target3 plus S2 extra_value. Native postFilter39 dispatcher is not executable-recovered; runtime uses injured HP-ratio priority with deployment-order ties. Talent exact strict-LT threshold is evaluated before base healing at each impact; native active-buff versus ordinary-heal action ordering is not recovered, so boundary-crossing ordering is explicitly an interpretation.

Honeyberry source S1/S2 postFilter38 highest-elemental-injury interpretation follows the Global descriptions, with HP-ratio priority on ties; native selector enum execution is not recovered. S1 performs ordinary elemental recovery plus source one-second additional recovery over selected duration, beginning after the first full interval. Fired recipient buffs expire independently of source withdrawal; native live-versus-cached ATK callback dispatch is not recovered and runtime uses live source ATK for periodic recovery.

Honeyberry talent validator deployPositionFromData2 is interpreted as source ranged deployment position, not terrain where the recipient currently stands. Source targetFree and isolated exclusions are retained for this non-HEAL aura; purposeMask0 does not reject HealFree/noHeal recipients. Mulberry global MEDIC aura explicitly ignores healFree and targetFree while retaining allyTargetFree exclusions, so an unhealable medic can receive the buff.

Honeyberry S2 native Heal has empty animKey, preDelay0.2,maxAnimScale-1 and continuous flag. Runtime uses explicit ability predelay0.2 and original lowercase skill_2_Begin/Loop/End cosmetically; unrecovered FSM entrance dispatch is not added to combat timing.

Mulberry S1 native animKey Skill_1 has no exact original skeleton clip; original Skill OnAttack0.567 is an explicit literal alias. S1 disables trait so elemental ratio is the selected ep_heal_ratio alone, without adding ordinary trait ratio0.5.

Mulberry S2 original native Heal uses empty animKey and explicit zero predelay, with no OnAttack in original Skill1_Loop. Source controller Skill_2_* names have no exact skeleton match; cosmetic original Skill1_Start/Loop/End aliases do not invent combat delay. Final BAT scaler uses native attribute8 formula3. Elemental protection template isOneMinustrue/isStackablefalse is implemented as the strongest live same-source channel with weaker fallback, leaving unrelated elemental modifiers intact.
